title: The Regulation of Osteoprotegerin by Mechanical Stimulation
brief_summary: To test whether levels of OPG can be changed during orthodontic treatment. Alveolar bone samples will be collected from partially impacted third molars after orthodontic uprighting for different period of time in volunteers. In situ hybridization and immunohistochemistry analysis for OPG and RANKL will reveal their roles in this physiological process.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with two mandibular impaction third molars containing at least one mesially angular impaction with crown exposed to the oral cavity

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy or diseases with abnormal bone metabolism
